# TenantNotice.online - LLM Context Manifest
> Precision statutory tenant and landlord notice generation platform with strict jurisdictional segregation between the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada.

## Core Jurisdictions
- [United States Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/us/): State-specific statutory notice generators for California, Texas, Florida, and New York.
- [United Kingdom Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/): Parliamentary compliant notice builders reflecting the Renters' Rights Act.
- [Canada Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/): Provincial statutory notice and calculation engines for Ontario (LTB), British Columbia (RTB), Alberta (RTDRS), Quebec (TAL), and Manitoba (RTB).
- [Legal Blog Hub](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/): Authoritative statutory legal analyses and tenancy dispute guides for US, UK, and Canadian jurisdictions.

## Global Interactive Tenancy Tools & Calculators
- [Global Notice Expiry Date & Statutory Day Calculator](https://tenantnotice.online/tools/notice-expiry-date-calculator): Interactive statutory day calculator supporting day-zero rules, weekend and court holiday exclusions (Florida/Texas), postal transit buffers (Ontario/BC/Manitoba), and rental period month-end alignment.
- [Interactive Lease Breach & Tenancy Notice Finder Wizard](https://tenantnotice.online/tools/lease-breach-wizard): Multi-step diagnostic matching tenancy issues, rental arrears, and covenant violations to mandatory statutory notice forms across US states, UK nations, and Canadian provinces.

## US Statutory Notice Utilities
- [30-Day Notice to Vacate Generator](https://tenantnotice.online/us/30-day-notice-to-vacate): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1946.1, Texas Prop. Code Section 24.005, Florida Stat. Section 83.57, New York RPL Section 226-c.
- [3-Day Notice to Pay Rent or Quit](https://tenantnotice.online/us/3-day-pay-rent-or-quit): Governed by California CCP Section 1161(2), Florida Stat. Section 83.56(3), Texas Prop. Code Section 24.005.
- [Security Deposit Demand Letter](https://tenantnotice.online/us/security-deposit-demand): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1950.5 (21 days), Texas Prop. Code Section 92.103 (30 days), Florida Stat. Section 83.49 (15 to 60 days).
- [24-Hour Notice to Enter Premises](https://tenantnotice.online/us/24-hour-notice-to-enter): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1954 and common law privacy covenants.

## UK Statutory Tenancy Utilities
- [Section 8 Notice to Quit Form 3](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/section-8-notice-to-quit): Governed by Housing Act 1988 reformed Schedule 2 possession grounds under the Renters' Rights Act.
- [Tenant Notice to Quit](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/tenant-notice-to-quit): Governed by Assured Periodic Tenancy termination rights under English common law and statute.
- [Tenancy Deposit Refund Demand](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/tenancy-deposit-demand): Governed by Housing Act 2004 Section 213 compliance and custodial schemes (DPS, TDS, MyDeposits).
- [Section 13 Rent Increase Challenge Form 4](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/section-13-rent-challenge): Governed by Housing Act 1988 Section 13 referral to the First-tier Tribunal (Property Chamber).

## Canada Statutory Tenancy Utilities
- [Ontario Form N9 60-Day Tenant Notice to End Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/ontario-form-n9): Governed by Ontario Residential Tenancies Act 2006 Section 44, enforcing 60-day calendar alignment with the final day of a rental period and Section 44(4) February statutory exception rules.
- [British Columbia RTB 1-Month Tenant Notice to End Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/bc-rtb-notice): Governed by British Columbia Residential Tenancy Act Section 45, enforcing full monthly rental calculation on the day preceding rent due dates and Section 90 deemed delivery rules.
- [Alberta Periodic Tenancy Notice to Terminate](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/alberta-periodic-notice): Governed by Alberta Residential Tenancies Act Sections 6 through 12, featuring dual-role execution (1 full rental month tenant notice and 3 full rental months landlord notice with mandatory Section 11 statutory cause).
- [Ontario Last Month Rent (LMR) Deposit Interest Calculator](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/ontario-lmr-interest): Governed by Ontario Residential Tenancies Act Section 106(6) and Section 106(7), computing annual statutory interest across official 2007 through 2026 rent increase guidelines with compound rent increase offset mechanics.

- [Quebec TAL Tenancy Notice Generator & Form Builder](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/quebec-tal-notice): Governed by Civil Code of Québec Articles 1851 to 2000 and Tribunal administratif du logement rules, calculating 3 to 6 month lease non-renewal windows, 6-month repossession notices, and Bill 31 lease assignment protections.
- [Manitoba RTB Tenancy Notice Generator](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/manitoba-notice): Governed by The Residential Tenancies Act (C.C.S.M. c. R119), generating Section 86 periodic termination notices, Form 10 rent arrears demands, and Section 98(3) school-age children protections extending tenancy through June 30.

## Authoritative Statutory Blog Articles (Canada, US & UK)
- [Tenant Privacy Rights and Landlord Entry Rules](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/tenant-privacy-rights-landlord-entry-rules): Legal analysis of the covenant of quiet enjoyment, 24-hour statutory advance notice windows under California Civil Code 1954 and Florida Statutes 83.53, emergency access exceptions, and tenant remedies against harassment.
- [Ontario Form N12 Eviction and Landlord Own-Use Legal Guide](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/ontario-form-n12-eviction-landlord-own-use-guide): Complete statutory analysis of Ontario Form N12 personal occupancy notices, mandatory 1-month rent compensation under Section 48.1, LTB hearing rights, and Bill 184 bad-faith damages.

- [California 30-Day vs 60-Day Notice Rules](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/california-30-day-vs-60-day-notice-to-vacate-rules): Statutory tenure benchmarks under Civil Code 1946.1 and Code of Civil Procedure Section 12 day counting rules.
- [California AB 1482 Just Cause Evictions & Rent Caps](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/california-ab-1482-tenant-protection-act-just-cause-evictions): Civil Code 1946.2 just cause requirements, mandatory relocation payments, and Section 1947.12 rent caps.
- [Texas Property Code 24.005 Notice to Vacate Procedure](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/texas-property-code-24-005-notice-to-vacate-procedure): 3-day notice rules, delivery affidavits, outside door posting restrictions, and Justice Court timelines.
- [Florida Statute 83.56 Three-Day Notice Rent Calculation](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/florida-statute-83-56-three-day-notice-rent-calculation): Mandatory exclusion of weekends and court holidays, rent definitions, and County Court dismissals.
- [Security Deposit Return Demand Letters: CA, TX, FL](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/security-deposit-return-demand-letters-california-texas-florida): Comparative statutory deadlines, wear and tear standards, and bad-faith punitive damages.
- [Renters' Rights Act Complete Guide: Section 21 Abolition](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/renters-rights-act-complete-guide-section-21-abolition): Abolition of Section 21 no-fault evictions and automatic conversion to rolling periodic tenancies.
- [Reformed Section 8 Form 3 Ground 8 Rent Arrears](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/reformed-section-8-notice-form-3-ground-8-rent-arrears): Mandatory 3-month rent arrears threshold, 4-week notice periods, and benefit delay defenses.
- [Ground 1A Landlord Intention to Sell Notice Rules](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/ground-1a-landlord-intention-to-sell-notice-rules): Mandatory 4-month notice period, initial 12-month tenancy protection buffer, and £40,000 penalties.
- [Tenant Statutory Notice to Quit Periodic Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/tenant-statutory-notice-to-quit-periodic-tenancy): 2-month written notice rules, flexible expiry dates, and joint tenancy surrender effects.
- [Challenging Section 13 Rent Increases in First-tier Tribunal](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/challenging-section-13-rent-increases-first-tier-tribunal): Form 4 limitations, tribunal market rent determinations, and application deadlines.
- [How to Calculate Prorated Rent When Moving In Mid-Month](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/how-to-calculate-prorated-rent-mid-month): Mathematical formulas (exact calendar days, 30-day banker's rule, 365-day annualized, leap year) and statutory tenant protections across California, Texas, Florida, and Ontario.
- [How to Legally Serve a 24-Hour Notice to Enter](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/how-to-legally-serve-24-hour-notice-to-enter): Statutory entry rules, normal business hours limits, emergency exceptions, delivery protocols, and tenant privacy protections under California Civil Code 1954, Florida Statutes 83.53, and Texas common law.
- [Rental Junk Fees: Are Your Landlord's Surcharges Illegal?](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/rental-junk-fees-illegal-landlord-charges-guide): Analysis of the FTC 48-million-dollar enforcement crackdown, California SB 478 hidden fee bans, non-rent eviction defenses under CCP 1161(2), and deposit recovery procedures.

## Authoritative Legal Guides
- [US Eviction Process and Statutory Timelines Guide](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/us-eviction-process-guide): Complete breakdown of notice windows, court filings, and service procedures.
- [UK Renters' Rights Act Comprehensive Guide](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/uk-renters-rights-act-guide): Guidance on Section 21 abolition, periodic tenancies, and possession grounds.
- [Security Deposit Return Rights Handbook](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/security-deposit-return-rights): Small claims court deposit recovery procedures for US and UK tenants.
